source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A true colour (TCI, 10 m), Earth Search STAC / AWS Open Data

period.summary: Floods in Mozambique from late December 2025; Copernicus EMS gives 10 January 2026 as the event time for the Limpopo (EMSR857). No end date in the sources used.

sources.says: Flood event time of the rapid mapping activation EMSR857.
Flooding began in late December 2025; Chókwè among the hardest-hit cities; no date for the water receding.
Title: Flooding in Mozambique, December 2025 to February 2026.

searched: All 85 Sentinel-2 L2A scenes covering the study area, 1 December 2025 – 31 May 2026
rule: A stage gets an image only when its capture date and what it shows support the stage. No image is used twice and no frame is made between captures.

frame.heading: Before the flood
frame.sentence: The Limpopo flows in its channel past the town.
frame.why: Last clear image before the flood reached the study area (9–19 January: 99–100 % cloud).
frame.catalog: Earth Search STAC (AWS Open Data), collection sentinel-2-l2a

frame.heading: First clear image during the flood
frame.sentence: First clear image of the flood: brown water covers the floodplain on both banks, up to the edge of the town.
frame.why: The flood began before any clear image: 22 January already shows floodwater but is half cloud (47 % clear); 24 January is 81 % clear.
frame.catalog: Earth Search STAC (AWS Open Data), collection sentinel-2-l2a

stages.title: Towards the end of the flood

frame.sentence: The river is still wide and standing water remains in the floodplain beside the town.
frame.why: Water is going down (scene classification: 35 % water on 24 January, 15 % on 8 February). The end is not confirmed, so the image is labelled with its date.
frame.catalog: Earth Search STAC (AWS Open Data), collection sentinel-2-l2a

frame.heading: After the flood
frame.sentence: Taken after the second rise in March: the Limpopo is back in its channel and the floodplain is green.
frame.why: Water rose on the floodplain again in March (20 March image); from 12 April the river is back in its channel. 27 April is fully clear.
frame.catalog: Earth Search STAC (AWS Open Data), collection sentinel-2-l2a
